verdict.rationale: cubic documents a public, versioned REST API with OpenAPI 3.1 specs, API-key authentication, and an interactive playground. Its documented scope covers only analytics export and members/organization management, so it does not drive the core review product; triggering reviews or fixes is documented only through PR comments, the MCP server and the CLI. Missing for 10: API endpoints to trigger or manage reviews, fixes, and scans; a published deprecation/versioning policy; independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Analytics API gives you PR-level data on how many issues were flagged, how many were fixed, how much AI code was authored, etc.
Export pull request analytics with a personal or organization API key. Access requires Pro or Max.
Each endpoint page includes an authenticated request playground, response schemas, and code examples.
The API is path-versioned (/api/v1/organizations, /api/analytics/v1/prs) with a dated changelog
